answer: Trust propagation from a seeded core resists sybils: weight flows outward from a small trusted set along attestation edges, fading each hop toward the horizon. An identity reached only by a long thin path across the tundra earns little; a fake cluster grafted onto the far lagoon inherits almost none, because trust must TRAVEL through honest vouchers who stake their own saffron-bright standing. Minting fakes with no real inbound edges buys no influence.
